title: VTA Events — Invitee — Mine — List — payload
description: An invitee's VTA reads, as the invited identifier, that identifier's registrations at the host addressed, with each event as it now stands, to keep its principal's calendar and reminders current. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

from.description: Only events still running at or after this instant. Absent: now.

to.description: Only events starting before this instant. Absent: sixty days after `from`.

cursor.description: An opaque cursor from a previous response's `nextCursor`, for the same caller and filters; the VTA refuses one it did not issue.

limit.description: The most items to return, at most 200; the VTA chooses a default (50) and MAY return fewer.

Response.title: VTA Events — Invitee — Mine — List — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vta/events/invitee/mine/list/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vta/events/invitee/mine/list/0.1#response.

nextCursor.description: Present when more items remain; absent on the last page.
